description: This file contains definitions and implementations for the ClassBrowser module of the SmartClient framework, including class definitions for JavaClassPane, JVMClassTree, and ClassBrowser, as well as associated methods and data sources.

classes.name: JavaClassPane
classes.description: A layout component that displays Java source code, with methods to load and display source code.

classes.name: JVMClassTree
classes.description: A TreeGrid component representing the Java class hierarchy, backed by JVMClassTreeDS data source.

classes.name: ClassBrowser
classes.description: Main component that integrates class tree and class pane, providing UI for browsing classes.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the widget, creates class tree, layout, and loads class source.

methods.name: loadSource
methods.description: Calls server to fetch Java source code for display.

methods.name: loadSourceReply
methods.description: Handles server response with Java source code, applies syntax highlighting.

methods.name: classChanged
methods.description: Handles selection change in class tree, updates class pane.

methods.name: showClassPane
methods.description: Displays detailed view of selected class.

methods.name: escapeForId
methods.description: Sanitizes class path for use as DOM element ID.

methods.name: showPane
methods.description: Displays a specific pane in the right tab set.

methods.name: showWindow
methods.description: Creates and shows the class browser window.
